channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to win 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League. It was the only Florida city selected.

item.title: Juno Beach debates fence replacement at JB-7 beach access after residents report trespassing
item.description: Colony Condos residents say people using the JB-7 public beach access have been cutting through their private property since the town removed a boundary fence in 2023 for safety reasons.

item.title: Boca Raton Community High School band to march in National Independence Day Parade
item.description: The Boca Raton Community High School band will march down the National Mall on July 4, representing Florida in Washington D.C.'s National Independence Day Parade.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive A rating from state
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County received an A rating from the state for the third year in a row, with 143 district-operated schools rated A or B.

item.title: Breast cancer patient denied coverage for reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark's insurance company, Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, denied coverage for a breast reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4 percent this year
item.description: According to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey, a holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4 percent from a year ago.

item.title: Woman dies in Hobe Sound house fire as community rallies around grieving fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside the couple's home. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.

item.title: Port St. Lucie moves forward with Midway Road expansion and Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial Turnpike interchange. The move is part of the $95 million Midway Road Widening Project.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock to close Monday for $3 million renovation, nearly doubling slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be complete by next Fourth of July.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after Anthem Blue Cross denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, was denied coverage for breast reconstruction surgery less than 24 hours before the scheduled procedure. Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield said the surgical mesh called GalaFlex is still considered investigational.

item.title: Hobe Sound community raises funds for man who lost fiance in deadly home fire
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside the couple's home. Friends launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild.

item.title: Autonomous transit company proposes elevated network connecting West Palm Beach to airport
item.description: Glydways, a California-based autonomous transit company, is proposing an elevated network of self-driving vehicles connecting downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport. Palm Beach County commissioners will hear the proposal Tuesday.

item.description: Stephen McCoy, a disabled and retired veteran in Lantana, saw a nearly $7,000 lien removed from his home and unfinished roof repairs completed after WPTV investigated his complaint against Seabreeze Roofing and Sheet Metal.
